newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MTBE steady, sellers await buyers return.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MTBE steady, sellers await buyers return.

text.p: Spot MTBE prices remained strong but steady in quiet trade on Tuesday, staying aloft due to tight supplies and interest by blenders.
On the U.S. Gulf Coast, spot July MTBE remained 95.25/96.25 cents a gallon, with offers for any August about a penny lower at 95.00 cents.
On the East Coast, New York Harbor prompt barrels held at 100.00/102.00 cents a gallon, with offers for any August down a half cent at 100.50 cents a gallon.
"It's been very slow. We are waiting for the buyers to come back in," said a U.S. MTBE broker.

Values have been running high for the past month due to tight supply caused by periodic production problems earlier this year. But players say inventories look likely to improve in the second half of August due to the restart of imports and the improvements in U.S. Gulf production levels.
Meanwhile, Alberta Enviro Fuels said on Monday it plans to shut its MTBE plant on Sept 1 for a four-week turnaround. The 15,000 bpd plant is expected to return online with a 19,000 bpd capacity.
